title: Teach Me Your Way, O Lord

questions.question: Incline your ear, O Lord, and answer me, for I am what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:1 (ESV): "Incline your ear, O Lord, and answer me, for I am poor and needy."

questions.question: Preserve my life, for I am godly; save your servant who trusts in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:2 (ESV): "...save your servant who trusts in you!"

questions.question: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for to you do I cry when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:3 (ESV): "Be gracious to me, O Lord, for to you do I cry all the day."

questions.question: Gladden the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord, do I lift up my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:4 (ESV): "Gladden the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord, do I lift up my soul."

questions.question: For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in steadfast love to all who call upon whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:5 (ESV): "...abounding in steadfast love to all who call upon you."

questions.question: There is none like you among the gods, O Lord, nor are there any works like whose?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:8 (ESV): "There is none like you among the gods, O Lord, nor are there any works like yours."

questions.question: All the nations you have made shall come and worship before you, O Lord, and shall glorify your what?
For you are great and do wondrous things; you alone are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:10 (ESV): "For you are great and do wondrous things; you alone are God."

questions.question: Teach me your way, O Lord, that I may walk in your truth; unite my heart to fear your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:11 (ESV): "unite my heart to fear your name."

questions.question: For great is your steadfast love toward me; you have delivered my soul from the depths of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:13 (ESV): "...you have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol."

questions.question: O God, insolent men have risen up against me; a band of ruthless men seeks my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:14 (ESV): "...a band of ruthless men seeks my life,"

questions.question: But you, O Lord, are a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:15 (ESV): "...slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness."

questions.question: Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:16 (ESV): "...and save the son of your maidservant."

questions.question: Show me a sign of your favor, that those who hate me may see and be put to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:17 (ESV): "...that those who hate me may see and be put to shame,"

questions.question: Because you, Lord, have helped me and comforted whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 86:17 (ESV): "because you, Lord, have helped me and comforted me."

key_verse_text: Teach me your way, O Lord, that I may walk in your truth; unite my heart to fear your name.
